description: User report (2026-09-14): live glasses show 'Speaker 1' while the transcript nearly identifies them ('Possibly Brandon Pollack'); the glasses should show their name. Evidence: rec_346918ee (17 s) L1 had windows at 2.1/6.2/10.0 s; liveIdentify runs every 10 s only on clusters with >=3 windows, so it never ran live (first eligible tick 20 s). Post-processing gave candidate 0.632. Fix: evaluate a new cluster as each of its first windows arrives, and on the glasses show a candidate as 'Name?' instead of 'Speaker N'.
title: Glasses name the likely speaker live, not Speaker 1
